# Daily check-in: open an app, wait for a button by its text, tap it.
from xscript.android import action, screen, system, ui

APP = "com.example.app"  # package name of the app to check in to
BUTTON = "签到"  # text on the check-in button (regex)

system.open(APP)
system.wait_for_package(APP, timeout=30)
if screen.ocr_click(BUTTON, timeout=15):
    ui.toast("checked in")
else:
    print("button not found:", BUTTON)
action.sleep(1)
action.home()

# Find an image on screen and tap it. Put a cropped screenshot at res/img/target.png.
from xscript.android import action, screen
from xscript.android.system import R

TARGET = R.img("target.png")

for _ in range(10):
    hit = screen.find_image(TARGET, confidence=0.9)
    if hit:
        print("found", hit)
        action.click(hit["center_x"], hit["center_y"])
        break
    action.sleep(1)
else:
    print("target.png not found on screen")

# Read text on screen with OCR and pull a number out of it.
import re
from xscript.android import screen

lines = screen.ocr()  # optionally rect=(x1, y1, x2, y2) to read one area
for line in lines:
    print(line["text"], line["confidence"])

nums = [m for line in lines for m in re.findall(r"\d+(?:\.\d+)?", line["text"])]
print("numbers:", nums)

# Settings UI: show res/ui/main.html, read the values, then work from the floating window.
from xscript.android import ui
from xscript.android.system import R

settings = {}

with open(R.ui("main.html"), encoding="utf-8") as f:
    win = ui.Window(f.read(), width="85vw", height="50vh")


@win.on("start")
def start(value):
    settings.update(dict(p.split("=", 1) for p in value.split("&") if "=" in p))
    win.close()


win.show(wait=True)
print("settings:", settings)


def hello():
    ui.toast("hello " + settings.get("name", ""))


ui.float_add_menu("hello", "", hello)
ui.float_show()
